subject: Slate Lockdown, MAP & EB Protocol — ACME close plan
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Slate Lockdown & MAP baseline for ACME — need EB playbook

Team —

We're in the final stretch for ACME. They verbally committed to a Q3 start but procurement and the exec-briefing (EB) cadence are the remaining gating items. I sketched a short mutual action plan (attached) and a proposed EB protocol that locks the executive slate for final approvals. Key asks:

- Confirm sponsor mapping (who owns each ACME exec ask). I recommend Tony Lee (Account Exec) owns Board-level sign-off and we designate an internal exec liaison for each ACME exec.
- Final evaluation plan items: performance SLOs they will test during the POC (latency at 8k context, patching windows, cost-per-token targets).
- EB meeting slots: propose two 45-min windows next week for the cross-company exec sync + procurement pre-brief.

Please review the attached MAP (ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the agenda (EB_meeting_agenda_v2.pdf). I need a clean slate to send to Emily by EOD Wednesday so they can lock their calendar. Reply with: sponsor mapping, any required legal/finance approvals, and availability for the two windows.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (Excel, 42KB), EB_meeting_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate Lockdown & MAP baseline for ACME — need EB playbook

Grace —

Draft looks solid. Quick notes:

- Sponsor mapping: I'll own the exec liaison for CTO-level conversations (I propose Samantha Reyes from ACME as the technical sponsor). Marissa, can you own the board liaison?
- Evaluation plan: I added a short matrix tab to the MAP with test vectors and pass/fail criteria; included a row for quantization checks at 4-bit and perf targets at 50 concurrent users.
- Procurement: Procurement typically wants T&Cs redlines before EB; recommend we slot a 15-min pre-EB legal touchpoint.

Availability for EB windows:
- Option A: 2027-06-30 14:00–14:45 PT
- Option B: 2027-07-01 09:00–09:45 PT

If ACME can't do those, we need to widen to 90-min and include top legal and finance. I'm attaching my small edits to the MAP (see ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx, 'Ben edits').

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (edited)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-28T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate Lockdown & MAP baseline for ACME — need EB playbook

All —

Agree with Ben. A couple of pragmatic items from my side:

- Legal redlines: Our standard carve on data retention and audit access will need explicit language for on-prem telemetry. I'll ask Legal to prepare a short addendum; can someone include Legal cc when we send the MAP to ACME?
- Exec slate: I suggest we mark 'fallback' execs in the MAP (in case the original sponsor is unavailable) — helps them avoid deadlocks during EB. I can draft the fallback column this afternoon.
- Customer-facing ask: can we include a one-page 'decision checklist' in the EB agenda so ACME execs know the exact approvals they're gating (procurement checklist + technical acceptance)?

I'll be OOO Friday morning but available after 1pm PT.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate Lockdown & MAP baseline for ACME — need EB playbook

Grace —

Thanks for sharing. The MAP and agenda are helpful. Quick replies from our side:

- Sponsor confirmation: Samantha Reyes (CTO) and Victor Huang (Head of Data) will be the technical sponsors; Teresa Wu (VP Finance) will be our procurement lead on the EB call. If Samantha is tied up, Victor can run the exec sync.
- EB windows: Option A (2027-06-30 14:00 PT) works for the internal sponsor group; however Teresa asked if we can push to 14:30–15:15 PT to accommodate the finance all-hands. Can you accommodate 14:30?
- Evaluation plan: Our bench team will run the latency tests, but they need your test harness and a 24-hour runway. Can Redwood provide the perf test vectors and a short runbook before EOD Thursday?

We can align legal redlines after EB but need to see non-negotiable clauses up front (data retention, export controls). Looking forward to the meeting — Emily

Emily Zhang
Head of Strategic Accounts, ACME Corp
emily.zhang@acme.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Legal Intake <legal_intake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T17:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate Lockdown & MAP baseline for ACME — need EB playbook (final)

Perfect — locking the slate. Final notes and next steps: 

1) EB slot: Confirmed 2027-06-30 14:30–15:15 PT (45 min). I'll send the calendar invite to all participants and include the EB agenda as the meeting doc.
2) Sponsor mapping: Samantha Reyes (ACME CTO) — technical sponsor; Victor Huang — secondary technical sponsor; Teresa Wu — procurement decision owner. Internal liaisons: Ben (CTO lane), Marissa (board/finance lane), Jordan (ops/infra).
3) MAP updates: Ben's edits are merged; Marissa will add a fallback column before EOD. Legal intake is looped for redline prep — Legal, please review the attached addendum draft and flag must-haves.
4) Evaluation/runbook deliverable: Jordan will publish the perf test vectors and a 24-hour runbook to the HubSpot deal link (https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2027-Q2-42) by 2027-06-30 20:00 PT. Emily, once we post the runbook, your bench team can begin the 24-hour ramp.
5) Decision checklist: We'll include a one-page decision checklist in the EB agenda covering procurement approval, technical acceptance, and timeline for go/no-go.

I'll send the invite and the MAP to ACME now. Thanks everyone for the speedy turnaround.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
